items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: The critics -- once again, it was like Arnette. Once they went through the period when they were putting him down because they didn't like the sound or whatever, they were uncritical.

ctx.x: That's kind of a bridge to what I was going to ask about. The critics -- once again, it was like Arnette. Once they went through the period when they were putting him down because they didn't like the sound or whatever, they were uncritical. He really could do nothing wrong.
